steps: Issuer creates bounded claims including audience and expiry.
Signing key protects the encoded header and payload.
Client transports the compact JWT to the resource.
Resource verifies signature and claims before trusting content.

lesson.scenario: A warehouse API verifies a compact signed token locally while treating every claim as issuer-controlled input.
